home.heroTitle: Turning crude into the fuel that keeps industry moving.
home.heroSubtitle: {{siteName}} operates a modern processing facility dedicated to refining crude oil into premium fuels and petrochemical products, backed by rigorous quality control and a firm commitment to safe, responsible operations.
home.introTitle: An independent refinery built on process discipline
home.introBody1: {{siteName}} was established to serve a simple purpose: convert crude oil into the fuels and petrochemical feedstocks that regional industry depends on, reliably and to consistent specification.
home.introBody2: Our facility combines modern distillation and processing units with an experienced technical team, giving us the flexibility to meet the evolving needs of both local and international offtake partners.
home.servicesSubtitle: Three service lines, each built around a distinct stage of the petroleum value chain.
home.pillarsSubtitle: Safety, environmental responsibility, and quality assurance are treated as operating requirements, not afterthoughts.
home.ctaBody: Tell us about your offtake, distribution, or exploration-support needs and our team will follow up.
home.processSubtitle: From crude intake to final dispatch, here's what happens inside our facility.

processSteps.title: Crude Intake
processSteps.body: Crude oil arrives by tanker or pipeline and is metered, sampled, and logged before entering storage.

processSteps.title: Distillation
processSteps.body: Atmospheric and vacuum distillation units separate the crude into its component fractions by boiling point.

processSteps.title: Treatment & Refining
processSteps.body: Treatment units reduce sulfur content and refine each fraction to finished product specification.

processSteps.title: Quality Testing
processSteps.body: Every batch is tested in-house against specification sheets before it's cleared for dispatch.

processSteps.title: Dispatch
processSteps.body: Cleared product is loaded and tracked from our gate through to delivery confirmation.

home.whySubtitle: A few reasons offtake partners stay with us longer than they expected to.

directness.title: Direct From Source
directness.body: No layers of intermediaries between you and the units that actually produce your fuel.

logistics.title: Logistics That Fit Your Schedule
logistics.body: Deliveries planned around your operating hours, not ours.

reach.title: Regional & International Reach
reach.body: Serving offtake partners across West Africa and beyond.

safety.title: Safety-First Operations
safety.body: No shortcut, deadline, or margin ever overrides a safety procedure.

about.heroSubtitle: An independent refinery built around process discipline, safety, and consistent product quality.
about.storyBody1: {{siteName}} was founded to address a persistent gap in regional fuel supply: too many buyers were relying on intermediaries several layers removed from actual production, with little visibility into how their fuel was sourced or tested.
about.storyBody2: We built our operation around the opposite approach — direct processing, transparent documentation, and a technical team that can answer detailed questions about our own product, because they're the ones running the units that make it.
about.storyBody3: That approach has shaped how we've grown. Every new client relationship starts with documentation and, where appropriate, an invitation to verify our processes rather than simply take our word for them.
about.missionBody: To process crude oil into fuels our clients can rely on without having to double-check, and to be straightforward about our capabilities when we can't.

values.title: Process Discipline
values.body: Consistent procedures at every stage, from crude intake to final product dispatch, so quality doesn't depend on who's on shift.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: Clients can request lab results, specification sheets, and process documentation — we treat scrutiny as normal, not an inconvenience.

values.title: Safety First
values.body: No delivery deadline or commercial pressure overrides a safety procedure. That's a rule, not a guideline.

values.title: Long-Term Relationships
values.body: We'd rather grow slowly with clients who trust our documentation than grow quickly with ones who don't ask for it.

about.leadershipBody: Our technical and commercial teams are organised so that enquiries reach someone who actually understands the relevant process or logistics question, rather than a generalist reading from a script. Individual staff contact details are withheld on this site — use the Contact page to reach the right department.
about.licenseNote: {{siteName}} operates under refining and environmental permits appropriate to its jurisdiction (Permit No. [Permit Number]). Prospective partners are welcome to request current permit documentation directly.
about.ceoQuote: We built this company on a simple idea: if you can't explain your process to a buyer standing in your own control room, you probably shouldn't be selling them fuel.

services.heroSubtitle: Three service lines covering crude processing, distribution, and exploration support.
services.introTitle: Built around the full value chain
services.introBody: From the moment crude oil arrives at our facility to the moment refined product leaves for delivery, each stage is handled by a dedicated team with the specific expertise that stage requires.

serviceDescriptions.refining: Crude oil processing through modern distillation and treatment units, producing refined fuels and petrochemical feedstocks to consistent specification.
serviceDescriptions.distribution: Coordinated delivery of refined products by road tanker and, where infrastructure allows, rail and pipeline, matched to client delivery schedules.
serviceDescriptions.exploration: Technical and logistical support services for upstream partners evaluating and developing regional hydrocarbon prospects.

refining: Treatment units for sulfur reduction and product finishing
In-house laboratory testing against product specification sheets
distribution: Road tanker delivery network across the region
Delivery scheduling coordinated around client operating hours
Product tracking from dispatch to delivery confirmation
exploration: Technical advisory support for exploration planning
Liaison support with regional regulatory processes
Available on a project or retainer basis

services.ctaTitle: Have a requirement in one of these areas?
services.ctaBody: Tell us what you need and the relevant team will follow up with next steps.

sustainability.heroSubtitle: Safety, environmental responsibility, and quality assurance, treated as operating requirements.
sustainability.introBody: A refinery that cuts corners on safety or environmental controls is a liability to everyone connected to it — its workers, its neighbours, and its clients. We structure our operations around that reality rather than around the minimum required to pass inspection.

pillarDescriptions.safety: Comprehensive HSE training, mandatory PPE compliance, and a zero-tolerance policy for unsafe shortcuts, regardless of production pressure.
pillarDescriptions.environment: Emission monitoring and control systems, responsible waste handling, and ongoing evaluation of lower-impact processing options.
pillarDescriptions.quality: In-house laboratory testing at every stage of production, with full batch traceability from crude intake through to final product dispatch.

sustainability.ctaTitle: Want more detail on our operating standards?
sustainability.ctaBody: We're glad to share our current safety and environmental documentation with prospective partners.

contact.heroSubtitle: Questions about our services, capacity, or documentation? Reach our team below.
contact.disclaimer: Submitting this form will open your email client with your message pre-filled, ready to send directly to our team.

legal.privacyBody: We collect the information you provide when you enquire about our services or contact our team, together with limited technical data needed to operate this site. We use this information to respond to enquiries and evaluate potential business relationships. We do not sell personal information to third parties. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting our team.
legal.termsBody: By using this website you agree to provide accurate information in any enquiry you submit. Product availability, specifications, and delivery terms are subject to individual assessment, applicable regulatory approval, and formal contractual agreement; nothing on this site constitutes an offer or guarantee of supply. Any dispute arising from use of this site or our services will first be addressed through our internal complaints process.
